unverified: The 4 mile radius is a note, not a geometry limit. The ordinance allows night use when the cart has headlights, taillights and turn signals; the map keeps the state daylight flag.

enforcement.note: Posted signs do not lift a ban. A designated street list that is not digitized stays red for plain golf carts.

cart_only_bans.label: Beaufort Ordinance 2025/28: golf carts only on secondary roads posted 35 mph or less. Ribaut Road, Boundary Street and Carteret Street (US 21) are primary roads.
